From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stark.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart -> Request for technical demo

Hi Vanessa,

I filled out the Quickstart docs CTA and wanted to follow up directly — we're evaluating Redwood for an inference layer powering product search across two services. Current snapshot: ~1M inference calls/day, tail latency sensitivity (<50ms for search ranking), and a mix of short and mid-length prompts. We're interested in a technical walkthrough focused on: batching strategies, KV cache/latency trade-offs, and quantization options for our stack (PyTorch -> ONNX runtime).

Would love 30–45 minutes with an engineer who can speak to deployment patterns and cost tradeoffs. My availability next week is fairly open mornings PT.

I've attached a small set of sample logs and a mini prompt-set to give context.

Attachments: quickstart-logs.zip (archive)

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Principal Engineer, Stark Commerce
alex.turner@stark.io
